verdict.rationale: Navan documents several building blocks of this workflow. It offers receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses and connects corporate cards. Its API covers custom company fields and option values, accounting and ERP settings, per-transaction activity history, and ERP integrations, and spend can be broken down by vendor and category. However, nothing explicitly shows that transactions are automatically coded at the point of spend with merchant, category, memo and receipt, so a review-only close is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit real-time or at-swipe auto-coding of category and GL, memo capture at transaction time, receipt matching to card transactions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that month-end close becomes a review.
